// This observer is specific to the one-if generated ByteOrReject helper.
// It copies only the prefix before that if, then returns the original if condition.
// Original generated files are not changed.
package main

import (
	"go/ast"
	"go/format"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		panic("usage: instrument generated.go observer.go")
	}
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	file, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, os.Args[1], nil, 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var helper *ast.FuncDecl
	for _, decl := range file.Decls {
		if fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && fn.Name.Name == "GoooComposedActivity0Call0" {
			helper = fn
		}
	}
	if helper == nil {
		panic("expected ByteOrReject helper missing")
	}
	ifCount := 0
	ast.Inspect(helper.Body, func(node ast.Node) bool {
		if _, ok := node.(*ast.IfStmt); ok {
			ifCount++
		}
		return true
	})
	if ifCount != 1 {
		panic("expected exactly one if")
	}
	last := len(helper.Body.List) - 1
	branch, ok := helper.Body.List[last].(*ast.IfStmt)
	if !ok || branch.Init != nil {
		panic("expected final unconditional if without init")
	}
	helper.Name.Name = "ObservedCondition"
	helper.Type.Results = &ast.FieldList{List: []*ast.Field{{Type: ast.NewIdent("bool")}}}
	helper.Body.List[last] = &ast.ReturnStmt{Results: []ast.Expr{branch.Cond}}
	file.Decls = []ast.Decl{helper}
	output, err := os.Create(os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer output.Close()
	if err := format.Node(output, fset, file); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
